items.summary: Nolan Traore suffered a strained right hamstring in Friday’s game and will be reevaluated in eight to 10 weeks, the Nets announced (via Twitter). The injury took place during the third quarter of an NBA Cup contest against Orlando. Traore grabbed at the hamstring after hurting it and was removed from the game after playing nearly 18 minutes.
